personalInfo.name: Brendan Siow
personalInfo.title: Senior Software Engineer
personalInfo.bio: I’m a software engineer based in Kuala Lumpur. My work spans payment platforms, automotive data services, and investment apps. I focus on clear interfaces, dependable services, and the details that make software easier to use and maintain.
personalInfo.headline: Built with intention.
personalInfo.heroSummary: I build reliable payment systems and backend services, with a focus on clear APIs and maintainable software.
personalInfo.aboutSummary: Based in Kuala Lumpur, with experience across fintech, automotive data services, and mobile apps.

description: Build payment systems for F&B merchants in Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia, and Australia.
Integrated more than 12 payment acquirers across QR payments, online checkout, card terminals, and SoftPOS.
Designed a unified checkout model across point-of-sale systems, kiosks, and online ordering.
Automated merchant onboarding with dynamic forms, e-signatures, document checks, and PDF agreements.
Built a merchant financing platform covering ledgers, repayments, settlement, and AI underwriting; the platform is pre-launch.
Developed and maintained Data Registry and Data Access Manager services for MB.OS.
Contributed to EU Data Act compliance through legal metadata and data classification.
Maintained OpenSearch and search services supporting more than 100 million data records.
Used Azure Event Hubs for event-driven messaging and collaborated across teams using Scrum.
Maintained and enhanced merchant and administration portals for the payment gateway.
Integrated e-wallets, Google Pay, and Apple Pay into the payment platform.
Maintained the Open API and integration documentation, and supported merchants with technical issues.
Built a low-code checkout button to simplify payment integration.
Developed and maintained investment apps using Flutter and React Native.
Led the iFAST Singapore mobile app revamp and maintained its subsequent releases.
Built internal Angular applications and mobile APIs with Java Spring Boot.
Promoted to Senior IT Specialist in April 2023.
Developed an e-commerce website with Magento and a mobile application with Ionic.
Integrated Magento v2 APIs for the mobile application.
Developed PHP websites with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, AJAX, and APIs.
